title: Criminology, B.S. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: University Park. Sibling of the already-built Criminology B.A. (CRIM-2026.json), reusing crim_catalog.json's already-fixed CRIM 12/SOC 12 -> CRIM 249 -> CRIM 250W prereq chain. Real difference from the B.A.: no World Language sequence, no B.A. Fields/World Cultures -- replaced by a mandatory STAT 200 (already common to both), plus a 21cr 'Option' (4 named options, each with real enumerated course codes: Business/Public Administration, Computing and Statistics, Legal Studies, Social Science Research -- so not a data-ambiguity wall). Picked Computing and Statistics for cleanest catalog reuse. Real hidden-prereq chain handled explicitly: the option's own prescribed SOC 470 needs SOC 207, which isn't otherwise scheduled anywhere in CRIM -- added SOC 207 explicitly, and narrowed the common 'SOC 1/3/5' requirement to literal SOC 1 (not the full 3-way OR) so the SOC 1 -> SOC 207 -> SOC 470 chain resolves deterministically regardless of which option the engine happens to pick first. UPDATE after the prereq-parser fix: STAT 200's real prereq_groups require MATH 21 (which needs MATH 4, which needs MATH 3) -- none of which were anywhere in this plan, same real gap found in CRIM-2026.json. Added the MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 chain explicitly (Semesters 1-3); this also unblocks the Computing and Statistics option's STAT 460/462/464, which all require STAT 200 (or STAT 240/250/401) as their own prereq. Also note: the freshly re-scraped crim_catalog.json now shows CRIM 249/CRIM 250W with empty prereq_groups (the CRIM 12/SOC 12 chain described above is no longer present in the on-disk catalog data) -- flagged for human review, not re-added here since catalogs/*.json is out of scope for this fix. HANDBOOK VERIFICATION PASS: found the department's own real, current (December 2024) 'CRIM_BS-Computing-and-Statistics-Checksheet.pdf' plus the shared Race/Ethnicity/Gender course list (sociology.la.psu.edu/wp-content/...) -- both far more granular than the bulletin. Real gaps fixed: (1) same Race/Ethnicity/Gender (2 occurrences) and 4XX CRIM Core-vs-Non-Core (2+2 occurrences) wiring as the B.A. build, via the real published lists. (2) A genuinely missing REQUIRED component of the Computing and Statistics option: the checksheet's own 'Additional Courses (16 credits)' line for this option requires 'MATH 110 and MATH 111 OR MATH 140 and MATH 141' as a mandatory calculus pair -- this was completely absent from the plan (MATH wasn't even in departments). Added MATH 140 (no prereq) + MATH 141 (needs MATH 140) explicitly and added MATH to departments; kept the already-scheduled CAS 483/CMPSC 203/STAT 460/462/464 as-is since they're all real, valid picks from the option's own course list (the checksheet's exact credit reconciliation of the 16cr line is itself imprecise about which combination of list courses is intended, consistent with the 'recurring minor source-summarization gap' already documented elsewhere in this session) -- the option is therefore now fully, rather than partially, represented.
